articles.title: Paul Skenes ‘ignores’ Olivia Dunne as she desperately begs him for a picture from the stands
articles.summary: Olivia Dunne knows she has a little more access to Paul Skenes than the average fan, but for nine hilarious seconds, she decided to pretend otherwise.
articles.body:
Olivia Dunne knows she has a little more access to Paul Skenes than the average fan, but for nine hilarious seconds, she decided to pretend otherwise.

As Skenes walked off the mound, Dunne spotted her boyfriend from the stands and immediately slipped into character. “Hey Paul, I'm a huge fan,” she shouted, before asking him for a picture as if she were desperately trying to get the attention of the Pirates star.

When Skenes kept walking, Dunne only made the act better. “I'm a big fan. I love you, please, please,” she continued, dramatically pleading with him while playing the role of an adoring fan being completely ignored by her favorite player.

The moment lasts only a few seconds, but that's what makes it work. Skenes appears to give her nothing as he leaves the mound while Dunne commits completely to the joke.

articles.title: Paul Skenes ‘ignores’ Olivia Dunne as she begs Pirates star for a picture from the stands
articles.standfirst: Livvy shouted that she loved him and pleaded for a photo, but Skenes just kept walking
articles.summary: Livvy shouted that she loved him and pleaded for a photo, but Skenes just kept walking
articles.body:
Olivia Dunne tried everything. She called Paul Skenes' name. She told him she was a huge fan. She asked for a picture. She even shouted that she loved him and begged, “Please, please.” Skenes just kept walking.

For a few hilarious seconds, anyone unfamiliar with their relationship could have been forgiven for thinking the Pittsburgh Pirates star had just brutally ignored one of the most enthusiastic fans in the stadium. Except, of course, the woman desperately trying to get his attention from the stands was his girlfriend.

“Hey Paul, I'm a huge fan,” Dunne shouted as Skenes made his way off the mound. “Can I have a picture? I'm a big fan. I love you, please, please.”

Olivia Dunne fully commits to the joke

The entire clip lasts only around nine seconds, but Dunne makes the most of every one of them. Rather than simply calling out to Skenes , she acts out the role of an excited fan hoping for one unforgettable interaction with the Pirates ace, even becoming increasingly dramatic when he appears to keep walking without giving her what she wants.

Dunne obviously doesn't need to beg Skenes for a photograph. The two have been together since 2023 , when their relationship began attracting attention while Skenes was still making his rapid journey toward the majors and Dunne was competing as a gymnast at LSU.

Their lives have changed considerably since then. Skenes has become one of the biggest young stars in baseball, while Dunne's gymnastics career has ended and she remains one of the most recognizable personalities to emerge from college sports. Through all of it, she has frequently been seen supporting Skenes from the stands.

This time, though, she wasn't interested in simply being the supportive girlfriend. For nine seconds, Olivia Dunne became another desperate Paul Skenes fan.

articles.title: Olivia Dunne sparks MLB fan backlash after joking about skipping Paul Skenes’ games
articles.summary: Olivia Dunne has faced backlash from MLB fans after posting a video joking about supporting Paul Skenes from the comfort of her couch instead of attending his games. Some fans criticized her for skipping stadium visits while still joining her boyfriend for events and private-jet trips, while others saw the video as harmless comedy and another reason people look for ways to criticize her. Dunne responded to the backlash with more humor, joking that the video could get her banned from attending games and showing that she is not too concerned about the criticism.

articles.title: Olivia Dunne under fire from MLB fans over controversial video
articles.standfirst: Fans took the joke more seriously than she expected
articles.summary: Fans took the joke more seriously than she expected
articles.body:
O livia Dunne is one of the WAGs who attracts the most attention , and her comments have also led to a series of responses a ccusing her of being careless with what she posts on social media. ​ ​At this point, many fans claim that now that there is not as much gymnastics content from Dunne as there used to be, she simply posts whatever comes to her mind , while also leaning into her relationship with Paul Skenes. Strong statements have appeared throughout the comments on TikTok.

Not everyone saw the video as a problem

Others simply viewed the video as comedy , arguing that there was nothing serious about the content and that people are just looking for reasons to criticize her.

The video that sparked the debate around her relationship with Paul Skenes was specifically about the games Olivia does not attend, but the context behind the video is what upset some fans . In it, Olivia is seen sitting comfortably on her couch, saying that Paul invited her to his 140th game of the year. The audio makes reference to the fact that she clearly supports him, but from a much more comfortable place than the stadium.

The criticism started to gain traction as fans who took the video seriously pointed out that it is interesting how she skips going to the stadiums, but when it comes to attending events and traveling on private planes, she is the first to join her boyfriend’s plans.

The backlash quickly became part of the joke

It is nothing new for Olivia to receive hate on social media, but the comments definitely got out of control. Olivia even joked that after posting the video, she would probably be banned from attending games , continuing with the humor.

It was a clear sign that she enjoys dark humor and is not afraid of what people may say in the comments.

articles.title: Pirates scandal as Oneil Cruz accused of using "fixer" after crash that killed three people
articles.standfirst: A new investigation has raised serious questions about how the 2020 case disappeared and the payments made to the victims' families.
articles.summary: A new investigation has raised serious questions about how the 2020 case disappeared and the payments made to the victims' families.
articles.body:
Pittsburgh Pirates star Oneil Cruz is facing renewed scrutiny over a 2020 car crash in the Dominican Republic that killed three people, after a new investigation alleged that a well-connected "fixer" helped make the criminal case disappear.

Cruz , then one of Pittsburgh's leading prospects, was driving a Jeep Grand Cherokee when he rear-ended a motorcycle carrying Yohan Saba Mercado, Deby Beato Charles and Daniela Perez Garcia at high speed.

Prosecutors initially accused Cruz of reckless driving and causing an accident resulting in death. Authorities also said after the crash that there was evidence he had consumed alcohol, although he wasn't ultimately prosecuted for driving while intoxicated.

Families received about $66,000 in settlements

The latest allegations center on businessman Santo Caraballo , who reportedly became involved after the crash and helped negotiate agreements with the three victims' families.

Those families received roughly $66,000 combined in return for documents withdrawing "penal, civil or judicial" claims against Cruz .

Mercedes Garcia, Daniela's mother , said she never wanted money and instead wanted Cruz held accountable.

"Rich people, especially baseball players, like to pay for dead people with money. I am poor, but I have honor," Garcia said.

Daniela's father, Porfirio Perez , also spoke about the settlement process and how he felt treated.

"Because they saw that I'm a simple person, they took advantage of me," Perez said.

Oneil Cruz case was eventually dismissed

The criminal proceedings were ultimately dismissed after the families withdrew their claims, allowing Cruz to continue his baseball career and eventually reach the major leagues with Pittsburgh.

Cruz's lawyer, Amauris Vasquez Disla , defended the outcome while acknowledging the scale of the tragedy.

He described what happened as "a profound tragedy for all parties involved, especially the victims' families."

The Pirates have also stood behind the previous legal resolution, saying the organization and Cruz "addressed this matter more than six years ago."

The new reporting doesn't overturn the Dominican court's dismissal, but it raises serious questions about how the case was resolved and the role money and influential connections may have played.

For the families of the three people killed, the legal case may have ended years ago, but the consequences clearly have not.
